title: Welsh Rarebit Stir Fry
description: A twist on the classic Welsh rarebit recipe, incorporating the bold flavors of Chinese cuisine. This dish combines the creaminess of cheese with the crunch of veggies.

ingredients.name: Welsh rarebit
ingredients.notes: Use store-bought or make your own

instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the spinach and stir-fry until wilted.
Add the Welsh rarebit, effervescent water, and mustard. Stir-fry until the cheese is melted and the mixture is smooth.
Stir in the sesame seeds (if using) and soy sauce.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional spinach if desired.
